requirements.summary: Search the catalogue for query, visit the first at most ten products in observed order, preserve missing fields, write their observed values to a workbook and close the browser even on failure.

outcomes.description: Search the catalogue using the sole public query input.
Collect at most the first ten products in observed order, without deduplication or sponsored filtering.
Visit every selected product and extract its observed name, description and price; preserve missing fields.
Write an actual Excel workbook at the approved destination.
Close the browser on success and verified failure.
